payload.explanation: The diagnostic report directly observed the business request (session_a93fb27fe423) blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_6bd2aa3cc5d4, which is idle in transaction after issuing the same UPDATE and waiting on ClientRead. The state report confirms session_6bd2aa3cc5d4 is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request and session_b88b823621a8 must not be touched. Rolling back the blocker releases the row lock so the pending decrement can complete; no evidence supports large-data, index, or vacuum causes.
